name: OPERATIVE_2026 (per-unit, regular-season slopes)
rationale: Sean 9/25: do not fit the amplitude to ~100 playoff series; set each term to the runs-per-unit slope measured on large regular-season samples, expressed per 2026 final-12 field SD so the engine is unchanged.

derivation.z_lineup_xwoba: 0.0291 runs/game per .001 xwOBA (45,592 RS team-games 2016-25, t 19; = linear weights) x 7.8 pts field SD
derivation.z_lu_kpct: -0.0722 runs/game per 1 pp K% (RS team-games, t -5.5) x 1.74 pp field SD
derivation.z_lu_oaa: -0.00558 runs/game per team OAA (28,690 RS games, t -6.3); lu_oaa ~ team OAA / 11.5 -> -0.064 per lu_oaa unit x 1.724 field SD (unit mapping approximate)
derivation.z_rot_oct: -0.0220 runs/game per starter Stuff point (28,690 RS games, t -9.9) x 5.9 field SD (rotation-average vs per-start stuff: same units, mapping approximate)

historical_series_check: 99 series 2016-25: pre-reg log-loss 0.6510, per-unit-all 0.6561 (P pre-reg better 0.82), offense-only 0.6623 (P 1.00). Per-unit is not fit to these series by construction.
refit: November 2026: re-derive RS per-unit slopes on 2017-2026; field SDs recomputed per field automatically.
